title: Plugin handshake info (v1alpha1)
description: Response body of GET /plugin/v1/info — the plugin's self-report at registration and every (re)start. The kernel checks id-match, protocol compatibility, and capability subset before issuing a service token.

id.description: Namespaced plugin id; MUST equal manifest metadata.id.

pluginApiVersion.description: The plugin-protocol maturity the plugin implements, e.g. 'v1alpha1'. The kernel checks this is one it supports.

capabilities.description: Capabilities the plugin believes it was granted; the kernel asserts this is a subset of the manifest's approved capabilities.

displayName.description: Optional human name for ops surfaces.
